planner.company_summary: Alexandra's Bikeshop is a Swiss SME with two stores selling bicycles and offering repairs. Revenue has plateaued for two years while younger customers expect online configurators, home delivery and trade-in. Repair booking is still by phone and data is scattered across POS, Excel and paper.
why_transform: Revenue plateau over the last two years
Younger customers expect digital services the shop lacks
Phone-based repair scheduling causes long lead times and unhappy customers
stakes: Losing e-bike commuters and families to online competitors
Business continuity through the generational handover
objectives: Improve customer experience across online and in-store touchpoints
Build a small but real digital marketing presence
Prepare the business for the next-generation owner
constraints: IT budget under CHF 60k for year 1
8 employees, none with deep digital skills
Data scattered across POS, Excel and paper repair tickets
retrieval_queries: digital transformation small retail SME customer experience
Digital Transformation Canvas customer centricity action field
cloud and data integration for SMEs low budget
change management digital skills small team

why_principles: Transformation is triggered by customer pressure and competition, not technology alone (Wade 2015)
A clear 'why' must be shared with staff before tools are selected

customer_centricity: Offer online repair booking and order tracking
Map customer journey across store and web
new_technologies: Adopt off-the-shelf SaaS rather than custom development
cloud_and_data: Consolidate POS, Excel and paper tickets into one cloud data source
digital_business_development: Add trade-in, home delivery and e-bike commuter bundles
process_engineering: Digitize the repair ticket workflow end to end
digital_leadership_culture: Train staff and name a digital champion in each store
digital_marketing: Run local search, Instagram and email campaigns for new segments

how_to_transform: Assess current maturity per action field before selecting initiatives
Sequence quick wins first to build momentum and trust
Review KPIs quarterly and adjust the roadmap

process: Standardized online repair intake and status updates
people: Digital basics training for all 8 employees
platform: Shopify extended with booking, plus a lightweight repair/CRM tool
partners: Local agency or freelancer for web and marketing support

pitfalls: Overloading staff with no digital skills

strategist.strategic_purpose: Become the most convenient local bike shop for commuters and families by digitizing repairs and the customer journey within a CHF 60k budget.

operational_pillars.process: Replace phone and paper repair handling with a digital booking-to-pickup workflow
operational_pillars.people: Train all 8 staff and appoint one digital champion per store
operational_pillars.platform: Extend Shopify and add one cloud repair/CRM tool; no custom development
operational_pillars.partners: Contract a freelancer or agency for setup and marketing, plus delivery partners

expected_value: Repair lead time reduced by about 30%
Phone booking calls cut by at least half
risks: Staff resistance or lack of skills slows adoption
Budget overrun on tool licences and integration
Dependence on a single freelancer or vendor
quick_wins: Online repair booking form on Shopify
Google Business profile and local SEO clean-up
